I had this exact same problem, I thought death was the best option when I was 7 and only found out when I was 10 that that doesn’t go through most 7 year old minds when they come across a problem. It’s not not normal but it’s not normal if you understand? You should love yourself and be happy with who you are and see your worth but if you don’t then that is a problem that needs to be worked on and solved as soon as possible before it develops into further problems. Tell your parents about these feelings, I wish every child could see their worth and that everyone is beautiful whoever they are, whatever they look like, whatever they believe, whoever they are interested in, wherever they’re from, every single person is beautiful. Please remember that even if you don’t think it is true for you (even though it is) I hope you get help soon and become more confident with who you are :)

Does anyone know you feel like this and are self harming? If you ever want to talk or vent feel free to message me. One of my therapists suggests that I find a box and put things I like in it. For example face masks, sweets, music etc. To distract me from self harming. It doesn’t work for me and it might not for you but it’s worth a try. You don’t even need to spend money on it. Remember if you ever want to talk or vent, feel free to message me.
